mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, title_manually_set, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, title_manually_set, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM conversation WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at < #{cutoff}
